<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram id="collection-center" name="Collection Center Network Pattern"> <mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="3600" pageHeight="1920" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="title" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=28;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#102a43;" value="Collection Center Network Pattern (10.4x.0.0/16)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="45" width="3480" x="40" y="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="subtitle" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=15;fontColor=#334e68;" value="One repeatable pattern deployed across three centers: Cauca (10.41.0.0/16), Huila (10.42.0.0/16), Tolima (10.43.0.0/16) inside 10.40.0.0/13. Shows zones, VLANs, SSIDs, perimeter firewall [D07], uplinks to hub [D05], production VPC tiers [D04], offline logistics, code-sheet printing, and inter-zone policy intent." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="3480" x="40" y="65" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_params" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f0f4f8;strokeColor=#627d98;strokeWidth=1;fontColor=#102a43;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=14;spacingTop=10;fontStyle=0;" value="CENTER PARAMETERS
- Pattern CIDR: 10.4x.0.0/16 within 10.40.0.0/13
- Cauca: 10.41.0.0/16 | Huila: 10.42.0.0/16 | Tolima: 10.43.0.0/16
- Summary Route: 10.40.0.0/13 routed via AWS Transit Gateway
- Authority: docs/collection-center-network.md & docs/addressing-plan.md" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="95" width="620" x="40" y="115" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_wan" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f0f4f8;strokeColor=#627d98;strokeWidth=1;fontColor=#102a43;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=14;spacingTop=10;fontStyle=0;" value="WAN & TRAFFIC CLASSES (ASM-084..086)
- Primary WAN: 100 Mbps symmetric (90M planned + 10M IPsec/control)
- Backup: Cellular LTE+ auto-failover; non-operational traffic dropped
- QoS P1: Network control (2/2M gtd) | P2: Logistics (44/11M gtd)
- QoS P3: Drone (5/20M gtd) | P4: Staff (28/7M gtd) | P5: Non-op (capped)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="95" width="680" x="680" y="115" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_trace" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f0f4f8;strokeColor=#627d98;strokeWidth=1;fontColor=#102a43;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=14;spacingTop=10;fontStyle=0;" value="TRACEABILITY & IAC BOXES (architecture.md sec 14, ASM-200)
- [D05] Association of Environment with Pattern Center (B05: TGW hub & VPN)
- [D07] Pattern Firewall Rules (B07: Perimeter firewall rule set CC-01..CC-DEF)
- [D04] VPC Tiers of Pattern Environment (B04: Production VPC pdn 10.82.0.0/16)
- Decisions: ASM-080..089, PD-090..096, ASM-079, ASM-124, ASM-140" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="95" width="760" x="1380" y="115" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_legend" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f0f4f8;strokeColor=#627d98;strokeWidth=1;fontColor=#102a43;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=14;spacingTop=10;fontStyle=0;" value="POLICY INTENT LEGEND
- Solid Green Arrow: Allowed Flow (Stateful rule, port & rule ID labeled)
- Dashed Red Arrow: Denied Flow (Explicit firewall deny / blackhole)
- Blue Line: Physical Uplink / 802.1Q VLAN Trunk
- Client Isolation: Enabled on cc-transport & cc-guest SSIDs" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="95" width="660" x="2160" y="115" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_resilience" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f0f4f8;strokeColor=#627d98;strokeWidth=1;fontColor=#102a43;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=14;spacingTop=10;fontStyle=0;" value="OFFLINE OPERATION GUARANTEE (ASM-079, ASM-124)
- WAN Down: Logistics reception app persists to local encrypted outbox
- Local Printing: Code sheets print locally over LAN (never crosses WAN)
- Local Auth: RADIUS runs on firewall with cached CRL chain
- Automatic Drain: Outbox drains to AWS application tier upon link recovery" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="95" width="680" x="2840" y="115" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="flow_tunnel_bak" Provider public IPs are external; WAN failover activates backup tunnel." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="45" width="520" x="90" y="595" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="node_firewall" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#dc2626;strokeWidth=3;fontColor=#991b1b;fontSize=13;fontStyle=0;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=25;spacingTop=14;" value="PERIMETER FIREWALL APPLIANCE [D07]
Edge: 10.4x.20.1 | Mgmt: 10.4x.10.1 | Gateways: 10.4x.Z.1
- Stateful Zone Inspection: Rules CC-01 to CC-DEF (firewall-policy.md sec 4)
- Dual IPsec VPN Tunnels: UDP 500 / 4500 NAT-T, IP 50 ESP to AWS Hub
- Subinterfaces: .1 default gateway for VLANs 101-105 and 110
- Gateway Services: DHCP server & DNS conditional forwarder (.1)
- Local RADIUS Server: 802.1X EAP-TLS with cached CRL for offline auth
- QoS Traffic Shaper: Priority 1 to 5 bandwidth guarantees and caps
- Dual Contexts: Internal LAN context vs Internet-only routing context" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="290" width="670" x="660" y="360" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="badge_d07" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dc2626;strokeColor=#991b1b;fontColor=#ffffff;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" value="[D07] Pattern Firewall Rules" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="28" width="230" x="1090" y="370" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="node_switch_box" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#2563eb;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#1e40af;fontSize=13;fontStyle=0;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=25;spacingTop=12;" value="MANAGED PoE ACCESS SWITCH (VLAN 110)
Management: 10.4x.10.2 to .9 | Static assignment
- 802.1Q Trunk from firewall on dedicated access trunk port
- Access ports with 802.1X EAP-TLS port admission for staff
- MAC-based port security for Code-Sheet Printers (ASM-124)
- Layer 2 only: does not route; switches only carry VLAN tags (ASM-080)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="135" width="630" x="1360" y="360" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="flow_fw_switch" edge="1" parent="1" source="node_firewall" style="strokeColor=#2563eb;strokeWidth=3;fontColor=#1e40af;fontSize=12;endArrow=block;" target="node_switch_box" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="1345" y="427" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lbl_fw_switch" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#2563eb;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#1e40af;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" value="802.1Q VLAN Trunk" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="24" width="150" x="1285" y="325" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="node_aps_box" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#2563eb;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#1e40af;fontSize=13;fontStyle=0;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=25;spacingTop=12;" value="MANAGED Wi-Fi ACCESS POINTS (VLAN 110)
Management: 10.4x.10.20 to .49 | DHCP reservation by MAC
- 5 SSIDs broadcast per radio (cc-management, cc-support, cc-logistics, cc-transport, cc-guest)
- WPA3-Enterprise (802.1X EAP-TLS) for staff zones; WPA3-Personal (SAE) for guests
- Client Isolation enforced on cc-transport & cc-guest SSIDs (ASM-081)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="135" width="630" x="1360" y="515" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="flow_switch_aps" edge="1" parent="1" source="node_switch_box" style="strokeColor=#2563eb;strokeWidth=3;fontColor=#1e40af;fontSize=12;endArrow=block;" target="node_aps_box" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="1675" y="505" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lbl_switch_aps" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#2563eb;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#1e40af;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" value="PoE + Trunk" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="22" width="100" x="1695" y="498" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="flow_fw_admin" edge="1" parent="1" source="node_firewall" style="strokeColor=#15803d;strokeWidth=3;fillColor=#15803d;fontColor=#14532d;fontSize=12;endArrow=block;" target="tier_admin" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="1300" y="650" /> <mxPoint x="1300" y="680" /> <mxPoint x="2270" y="680" /> <mxPoint x="2270" y="990" /> <mxPoint x="2675" y="990" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="zone_gerencia" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#475569;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=14;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=30;spacingTop=16;fontStyle=1;" value="GERENCIA (Management) | VLAN 101 | CIDR: 10.4x.1.0/24
- SSID: cc-management (WPA3-Enterprise 802.1X EAP-TLS)
- Gateway: 10.4x.1.1 (Firewall subinterface)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="460" width="560" x="70" y="720" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="node_gerencia_detail" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#94a3b8;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=18;spacingTop=14;fontStyle=0;" value="Gerencia Operational Context
- Planned Clients: 2 wired desktops, 5 Wi-Fi smartphones (7 clients)
- DHCP Pool: 10.4x.1.50 to .69 (20 hosts, lease 12 h)
- Traffic Class: Staff Class (Priority 4, 28/7 Mbps guaranteed)
- Allowed Flows:
 * AWS Application tier: Center web app & reports [CC-STF-01] (TCP 443)
 * Local Code-Sheet Printers: Administrative printing [CC-STF-02] (TCP 631)
 * External Internet: Web breakout [CC-STF-04] (TCP 80/443, UDP 443)
- Explicit Deny: Inter-zone to Soporte, Logística, Guests [CC-STF-03]" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="325" width="520" x="90" y="825" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="zone_servidores" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#475569;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=14;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=30;spacingTop=16;fontStyle=1;" value="SERVIDORES LOCALES (Local Servers) | VLAN 110 | CIDR: 10.4x.10.0/24
- SSID: None (Wired infrastructure only, fixed switch ports)
- Gateway: 10.4x.10.1 (Firewall management interface)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="460" width="670" x="660" y="720" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="node_printers" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f0fdf4;strokeColor=#16a34a;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#14532d;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=18;spacingTop=14;fontStyle=0;" value="Code-Sheet Network Printers (10.4x.10.50 to .59)
- Two network printers wired to PoE switch with MAC port security (ASM-124)
- Local Print Ingress (TCP 631 IPP):
 * From Logística: Un-coded coffee sack tags [CC-LOG-02]
 * From Gerencia & Soporte: Administrative printing [CC-STF-02]
- Offline Operation: Print jobs stay local on LAN; never cross WAN (ASM-124)
- Ingress Only: Printers never initiate outbound traffic [CC-ADM-04]
- Ingress Administration: Accepted strictly from Cloud admin tier [CC-ADM-01]" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="325" width="630" x="680" y="825" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lbl_stf_print" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#15803d;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#14532d;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" value="CC-STF-02: Staff print (TCP 631 IPP)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="24" width="250" x="870" y="792" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="flow_gerencia_print" edge="1" parent="1" source="node_gerencia_detail" style="strokeColor=#15803d;strokeWidth=3;fillColor=#15803d;fontColor=#14532d;fontSize=12;endArrow=block;" target="node_printers" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="645" y="960" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="flow_soporte_print" edge="1" parent="1" source="node_drone_station" style="strokeColor=#15803d;strokeWidth=3;fillColor=#15803d;fontColor=#14532d;fontSize=12;endArrow=block;" target="node_printers" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="1345" y="960" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="zone_soporte" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#475569;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=14;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=30;spacingTop=16;fontStyle=1;" value="SOPORTE (Support) | VLAN 102 | CIDR: 10.4x.2.0/24
- SSID: cc-support (WPA3-Enterprise 802.1X EAP-TLS)
- Gateway: 10.4x.2.1 (Firewall subinterface)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="460" width="630" x="1360" y="720" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="node_drone_station" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fef3c7;strokeColor=#d97706;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#78350f;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=18;spacingTop=14;fontStyle=0;" value="Drone Ground Station: 10.4x.2.10/32 (Fixed DHCP Reservation)
- Contracted operator ground station (ADR-002, ASM-082)
- Private client certificate for network and cloud authentication
- Allowed Cloud Ingress:
 * Application tier: Mission preload & upload grant [CC-DRN-01] (TCP 443)
 * Object storage tier: Multipart flight & imagery upload [CC-DRN-03] (TCP 443)
 * AWS IoT Core: Kit grant topic via local breakout [CC-DRN-04] (TCP 8883)
- Explicit Denies:
 * drone_object_ingress tier (RESERVED in pilot, ASM-140) [CC-DRN-02] DENIED
 * Any other destination [CC-DRN-05]; rest of Soporte denied drone paths [CC-DRN-06]" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="325" width="590" x="1380" y="825" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell div.div: One repeatable pattern deployed across three centers: Cauca (10.41.0.0/16), Huila (10.42.0.0/16), Tolima (10.43.0.0/16) inside 10.40.0.0/13. Shows zones, VLANs, SSIDs, perimeter firewall [D07], uplinks to hub [D05], production VPC tiers [D04], offline logistics, code-sheet printing, and inter-zone policy intent.

CENTER PARAMETERS
- Pattern CIDR: 10.4x.0.0/16 within 10.40.0.0/13
- Cauca: 10.41.0.0/16 | Huila: 10.42.0.0/16 | Tolima: 10.43.0.0/16
- Summary Route: 10.40.0.0/13 routed via AWS Transit Gateway
- Authority: docs/collection-center-network.md & docs/addressing-plan.md

div.div:
WAN & TRAFFIC CLASSES (ASM-084..086)
- Primary WAN: 100 Mbps symmetric (90M planned + 10M IPsec/control)
- Backup: Cellular LTE+ auto-failover; non-operational traffic dropped
- QoS P1: Network control (2/2M gtd) | P2: Logistics (44/11M gtd)
- QoS P3: Drone (5/20M gtd) | P4: Staff (28/7M gtd) | P5: Non-op (capped)

- [D07] Pattern Firewall Rules (B07: Perimeter firewall rule set CC-01..CC-DEF)
- [D04] VPC Tiers of Pattern Environment (B04: Production VPC pdn 10.82.0.0/16)
- Decisions: ASM-080..089, PD-090..096, ASM-079, ASM-124, ASM-140

POLICY INTENT LEGEND
- Solid Green Arrow: Allowed Flow (Stateful rule, port & rule ID labeled)
- Dashed Red Arrow: Denied Flow (Explicit firewall deny / blackhole)
- Blue Line: Physical Uplink / 802.1Q VLAN Trunk
- Client Isolation: Enabled on cc-transport & cc-guest SSIDs

div.div:
OFFLINE OPERATION GUARANTEE (ASM-079, ASM-124)
- WAN Down: Logistics reception app persists to local encrypted outbox
- Local Printing: Code sheets print locally over LAN (never crosses WAN)
- Local Auth: RADIUS runs on firewall with cached CRL chain
- Automatic Drain: Outbox drains to AWS application tier upon link recovery

div.div:
PERIMETER FIREWALL APPLIANCE [D07]
Edge: 10.4x.20.1 | Mgmt: 10.4x.10.1 | Gateways: 10.4x.Z.1
- Stateful Zone Inspection: Rules CC-01 to CC-DEF (firewall-policy.md sec 4)
- Dual IPsec VPN Tunnels: UDP 500 / 4500 NAT-T, IP 50 ESP to AWS Hub
- Subinterfaces: .1 default gateway for VLANs 101-105 and 110
- Gateway Services: DHCP server & DNS conditional forwarder (.1)
- Local RADIUS Server: 802.1X EAP-TLS with cached CRL for offline auth
- QoS Traffic Shaper: Priority 1 to 5 bandwidth guarantees and caps
- Dual Contexts: Internal LAN context vs Internet-only routing context

- Access ports with 802.1X EAP-TLS port admission for staff
- MAC-based port security for Code-Sheet Printers (ASM-124)
- Layer 2 only: does not route; switches only carry VLAN tags (ASM-080)

div.div:
Gerencia Operational Context
- Planned Clients: 2 wired desktops, 5 Wi-Fi smartphones (7 clients)
- DHCP Pool: 10.4x.1.50 to .69 (20 hosts, lease 12 h)
- Traffic Class: Staff Class (Priority 4, 28/7 Mbps guaranteed)
- Allowed Flows:
* AWS Application tier: Center web app & reports [CC-STF-01] (TCP 443)
* Local Code-Sheet Printers: Administrative printing [CC-STF-02] (TCP 631)
* External Internet: Web breakout [CC-STF-04] (TCP 80/443, UDP 443)
- Explicit Deny: Inter-zone to Soporte, Logística, Guests [CC-STF-03]

* Public Sack Lookup: Front door lookup [CC-PUB-01] (TCP 443)
- Explicit Denies:
* Internal LAN & Cloud tiers [CC-GST-02, CC-GST-03] DENIED
* Outbound SMTP port 25 relaying [CC-GST-04] DENIED

* Public Sack Lookup: TCP 443 [CC-PUB-01]
- Explicit Denies: Internal LAN [CC-GST-01], Cloud [CC-GST-03], SMTP 25 [CC-GST-04]

AWS IoT Core Data Endpoint (Public us-east-1) [CL-TEL-01]
- TCP 8883 (MQTT over TLS, mutual X.509 client certificate authentication)
- Used by Drone Ground Station (10.4x.2.10/32) for grant topic [CC-DRN-04]
- Telemetry ingress reservation in VPC is not used for collection centers (ASM-140)

div.div:
Public Application API Front Door & Sack Lookup [CL-TEL-03, CC-PUB-01]
- Amazon CloudFront + AWS WAF + Cognito token validation (TCP 443)
- Reached by Transporters (10.4x.4.0/24) for positions & custody events [CC-TEL-02]
- Reached by Transporters & Visitors for public sack lookup [CC-PUB-01]
- Logística reads sacks privately through tunnel application endpoint [CC-LOG-01]

div.div:
External Internet Web & Vendor Update Services [CC-STF-04, CC-GST-05]
- TCP 80/443, UDP 443 for Gerencia/Soporte staff web access (staff class, 28/7 Mbps gtd)
- TCP 80/443 for Transporte & Visitantes non-operational web (strictly capped, Priority 5)
- Vendor OS/device management update allow-list for Logística [CC-LOG-03]
- Port 25 SMTP relaying from guest/transporter phones [CC-GST-04] DENIED
- Inbound connection initiation from internet to center [CC-LNK-08] DENIED
